en.title: GTA 6's Rumored Lucia Actress Masterfully Dodges Fan Frenzy on Livestream
en.summary: The actress widely believed to be playing Lucia in Grand Theft Auto VI has gone viral after skillfully navigating a deluge of game-related questions during a recent Instagram Live. Her calm deflection has only fueled further speculation among eager fans.
en.body:
The internet's sleuths have been working overtime piecing together the cast of the highly anticipated **Grand Theft Auto VI**, and one name that has consistently surfaced is **Manni L. Perez**, rumored to be the actress behind protagonist **Lucia**. Recently, Perez found herself at the center of fan attention not for an official announcement, but for her adept handling of a barrage of **GTA 6** comments during an Instagram livestream.

With **GTA 6** slated for release on November 19, 2026, the pressure to confirm cast details is mounting. Rockstar Games has maintained its characteristic silence regarding the game's actors, a vacuum that fans have eagerly filled with their own theories. Perez, whose Instagram account saw a significant surge in activity, recently went live for approximately 12 minutes, attracting over 2,100 viewers. During this stream, she deliberately steered clear of any direct mention of **Grand Theft Auto** or her potential role, opting instead to share personal anecdotes about growing up in a small town and her current life.

## Navigating the Noise

Despite the overwhelming presence of **GTA 6** and "Lucia" in the comments section, Perez maintained a composed demeanor. She spoke about her life, her studio apartment shared with her dog, and her gratitude for her current circumstances. When fans assumed she was wealthy, she clarified, "I'm not rich. I'm a regular person. I live in a small studio apartment, which I love. I have my tiny, little itty-bitty kitchen, and it's just me and my dog. I do everything on my own, and I've done everything on my own for a very long time, and I love it, and I'm very grateful." This personal touch, while charming, served as a masterclass in deflection, keeping the focus on her as an individual rather than the rumored video game icon.

## The Fan Theory Mill

Fans have been speculating about Perez's involvement for years, a theory bolstered by her minor, yet confirmed, work in **GTA Online**. Her physical resemblance to the character model glimpsed in trailers further fuels this fan conjecture. The intensity of this speculation led Perez to deactivate her Instagram account previously, only to return on September 1, 2026. Her refusal to engage with direct questions about **GTA 6**, coupled with past instances like her reportedly declining to answer a question about Donald Trump in another public encounter, has only served to deepen the mystery and solidify her status as the prime candidate for Lucia in the eyes of the community.

## What's Next

With **GTA 6**'s release date drawing nearer, official cast confirmations are expected. Until then, the speculation surrounding **Manni L. Perez** and her role as **Lucia** will undoubtedly continue to be a hot topic among **Grand Theft Auto** enthusiasts worldwide.
